summary: Recent updates to Firefox have improved the way the browser handles autoplay for media, particularly when there are interruptions to the audio session. The changes now block the automatic start of media that requires user interaction before it can play, such as videos with sound, during these interruptions. This enhancement aims to create a more seamless and user-friendly experience, ensuring that users aren't abruptly caught off guard by media starting unexpectedly when they are in the middle of something else, thereby promoting a more controlled playback environment for users. **This change matters because it enhances user focus and respects their audio context, preventing unwanted distractions.**
